title: Context-pulled event payload v0.2 (0ds M1-S4 read-only context pull)
description: 0ds M1-S4 (2026-10-28, 366 charter / architecture §13-5; 0ds M1 v1 audit fix): a read-only context pull served by `context_manage(mode=map|recenter)`. The payload is a mechanical audit row — mode, provider-token estimate, delivered/candidate block or round counts and the rendered-output digest — not the rendered text itself; the text stays in the tool result and is never injected as resident context. `blocks` / `recent_rounds` are what the model actually received; `total_*` is the pre-truncation candidate count and `omitted_*` is total-delivered. `mode=map` reads the compact block table (recent_rounds=0, total_recent_rounds=0); `mode=recenter` reads state + the last complete rounds (blocks=0, total_blocks=0).

mode.description: Read-only context view that was served.

read_only.description: Always true: this event records a pull, never a mutation.

token_estimate.description: Provider-tokenizer count of the rendered output (M1 contract: <=1K).

blocks.description: Number of compact-map rows actually delivered to the model (0 for recenter).

total_blocks.description: Pre-truncation candidate block count (0 for recenter).

recent_rounds.description: Number of complete tool rounds actually delivered by recenter (0 for map).

total_recent_rounds.description: Pre-truncation candidate round count (0 for map).

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact rendered output handed to the model.

output_chars.description: Unicode scalar count of the rendered output.
